itens.titulo: TSMC posts record profit for a sixth straight quarter, beating estimates on AI boom
itens.descricao: TSMC posts record profit for a sixth straight quarter, beating estimates on AI boom CNBC
trechos: TSMC's third-quarter operating margin came in at 58.7%, exceeding the upper end of its guidance range of 58%, showcasing the pricing power enjoyed by the company as the AI boom fuels demand for semiconductors.

TSMC forecast fourth-quarter revenue between $52.3 billion and $54.3 billion, representing a 14% sequential increase and a 58% jump from a year earlier at the midpoint of its guidance range, according to the company's earnings call.
The chipmaker expects its capital expenditure from 2026 to 2028 to be significantly higher than in the previous three years, as it continues to ramp up investments to support growing customer demand.
TSMC expects its fourth-quarter business to be supported by continued strong demand for its advanced chipmaking technologies, including the ramp-up of its 2-nanometer process.

"Even after those checks, TSMC says demand remains well above its supply capacity," he said, adding that it reinforces confidence in the AI buildout while ensuring investment decisions reflect customers' ability to deploy the chips they order.
Advanced technologies, defined as 7-nanometer and more advanced technologies, made up for 79% of TSMC's total wafer revenue in the reported.
The 3-nanometer chips accounted for the largest share of its revenue in the third quarter at 33%, followed by 5- and 7-nanometer chips.
By platform, high-performance computing accounted for the largest share of revenue at 68%, followed by smartphones at 21%.

itens.titulo: Nearly $1 billion in crypto bets liquidated as bitcoin, ether and XRP slide
itens.descricao: Nearly $1 billion in crypto bets liquidated as bitcoin, ether and XRP slide CoinDesk
trechos: Nearly $1 billion in crypto bets liquidated as bitcoin, ether and XRP slide Ether accounted for nearly 60% of the forced closures across the two largest cryptocurrencies, falling roughly twice as much as bitcoin.
- Nearly $483 million in bitcoin and ether futures positions were liquidated over 24 hours as uncertainty about the Federal Reserve’s next interest-rate decision weighed on cryptocurrency markets.
- Ether traders bore the brunt of the sell-off, with about $286 million in liquidations as ether fell more than 6 percent to roughly $2,350.
- Bitcoin declined about 3 percent to around $81,000, while losses spread to smaller tokens including Solana, dogecoin and Zcash.
Nearly $483 million in bitcoin and ether futures positions were closed over the past 24 hours as cryptocurrency prices fell Thursday, with ether traders taking the largest hit.
Bitcoin traded around $81,000, down roughly 3% over 24 hours, while ether lost more than 6% to about $2,350.
XRP and Solana’s SOL fell around 5%, and dogecoin dropped roughly 6%.
Ether contracts accounted for about $286 million of liquidations, compared with $197 million for bitcoin, according to CoinGlass data checked during Asian morning hours.

itens.titulo: Bank of America stock sinks as $1.2 billion fine weighs on Q3 earnings
itens.descricao: Bank of America stock sinks as $1.2 billion fine weighs on Q3 earnings Yahoo Finance
trechos: Bank of America's (BAC) stock dropped 4.7% Wednesday after paring some losses as a $1.2 billion regulatory penalty dragged down the major lender's third quarter results.
The nation's second biggest bank reported third quarter net income of $6.93 billion, or $0.91 per share, compared with the $1.10 per share analysts expected.
Excluding the regulatory penalty, Bank of America said it earned $8.1 billion, or $1.08 per share.
Revenue rose 3% to $30 billion, compared with expectations of roughly $30.6 billion.
On a call with analysts Wednesday, CEO Brian Moynihan said the bank spent more than $200 million on remediation efforts during the quarter and has assigned thousands of employees to the work.
"We have a clear understanding of what we need to do.
And it is the focus of management to get it cleaned up," Moynihan said.
Investment banking fees fell 11% from a year earlier to $1.8 billion while still surpassing analyst forecasts.

itens.descricao: Agenda de empresas: Direcional divulga prévia operacional; Americanas vende imóveis por R$ 130 milhões Valor Econômico
trechos: Plano&Plano  A incorporadora Plano&Plano registrou no terceiro trimestre cinco lançamentos, que somaram um valor geral de venda (VGV) potencial de R$ 1,07 bilhão, queda de 50% sobre o mesmo período de 2025, quando a companhia lançou nove empreendimentos.
O conselho de administração da Telefônica Brasil aprovou o pagamento de juros sobre capital próprio no montante líquido de R$ 371,25 milhões, o equivalente a R$ 0,11617 por ação.
Cogna  A BlackRock atingiu uma participação na Cogna de 104.345.370 ações ordinárias, representando aproximadamente 5,055% do total de papéis ordinários emitidos pela companhia.
Prio  A gestora Orbis Investment Management Limited passou a deter 44.020.546 ações ordinárias da Prio, o equivalente a 5,05% do capital social da empresa.
Even  As vendas líquidas da Even no terceiro trimestre de 2026 totalizaram R$ 268 milhões, sendo R$ 185 milhões na parte pertencente à empresa, uma queda anual de 77,5%.
Itaú  O Itaú Unibanco selou um acordo para adquirir 35% da Prisma Capital, gestora de ativos alternativos que reúne cerca de R$ 28 bilhões.
Trata-se de um investimento estratégico na asset fundada em 2017, nos moldes do que o banco fez na Kinea décadas atrás.

itens.titulo: If I Can Only Own Alphabet or Amazon for The Next 5 Years, I’m Choosing This One
itens.descricao: If I Can Only Own Alphabet or Amazon for The Next 5 Years, I’m Choosing This One Yahoo Finance
trechos: Quick Read - GOOGL trades at ~15x earnings versus AMZN's ~35x, yet Google Cloud grew 82% against AWS's 37%, making Alphabet the cheaper, faster-growing pick.
- Alphabet controls its entire AI stack, including models, chips, and distribution, but nearly doubled long-term debt to $98B to fund the buildout.
- Over five years, GOOGL returned 148% against AMZN's 49%, with Google's earnings growth driving most of that outperformance.
Google Cloud Speeds Up While AWS Finally Reaccelerates Google Cloud revenue grew 82% to $24.77B, faster than the 63% it posted in Q1.
Search and other revenue rose 17%, and AI features drove query growth.
Sundar Pichai said "the Gemini App has 950 million monthly active users," and that gives Google a consumer AI audience few companies can match.
At Amazon, AWS grew 36.7%, its fastest rate in 18 quarters.
Its operating margin was 39% and its backlog reached $496 billion, so the demand looks signed and profitable.
